title: File:Cruise Ship Aida in the Varna Harbour (6070499202).jpg
desc:
Aida Aura, built in 2003, dimensions (meters): 202 x 28 x 6, engine 27100kW, speed 19 knots (~36 km/h). 10 passenger decks, 1300 passengers, 420 crew.

Cruising from Antalya, Izmir, Istanbul, Sochi, Yalta, Odessa, Varna, Thessaloniki, Samos, Rhodos, and back to Antalya. Cheapest tour is ~2000EUR
